title: Rate Plan Fences for Room Reservations
content:
A fence is a condition a reservation must carry to be sold a Room Reservations rate plan. The matrix sets out each plan's fences: whether an active Ashbury Rewards membership must be attached, whether only direct channels may book it, whether a corporate client code must be quoted, whether the reservation must sit inside a group block, the brands at which the plan is not sold, whether Free Night Award nights may appear on it, and how many shoulder nights around a block may be booked at the group rate.

| Rate plan | Ashbury Rewards membership required | Direct channels only | Corporate client code required | Must be booked inside a group block | Not sold at | Free Night Award nights allowed | Shoulder nights at the group rate |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Advance Purchase Non-Refundable Rate | No | No | No | No | — | No | 0 |
| Semi-Flexible Saver Rate | No | No | No | No | — | No | 0 |
| Flexible Rate | No | No | No | No | — | No | 0 |
| Member Flexible Rate | Yes | Yes | No | No | — | No | 0 |
| Bed & Breakfast Package Rate | No | No | No | No | Ashbury Express, Ashbury Inn & Suites | No | 0 |
| Corporate Negotiated Rate | No | No | Yes | No | — | No | 0 |
| Group Block Rate | No | No | No | Yes | — | No | 3 |
| Reward Night Rate | Yes | Yes | No | No | — | Yes | 0 |

## Definitions

- **Direct channels** are the brand website, the mobile app, the call center and the hotel itself (property direct).
- **Shoulder nights at the group rate** are the nights immediately before the block's arrival date and after its departure date that may be booked at the group rate, counted on each side.
- **Not sold at** lists the hotel brands at which the plan is not sold; a dash means the plan is sold at every brand.

## Reading the matrix

- The Advance Purchase Non-Refundable, Semi-Flexible Saver and Flexible Rates carry none of the fences in this matrix.
- Two plans require an attached Ashbury Rewards membership and direct booking: the Member Flexible Rate and the Reward Night Rate.
- The Reward Night Rate is the only plan on which Free Night Award nights may appear.
- The Group Block Rate is the only plan with shoulder nights: 3 before the block's arrival date and 3 after its departure date.
- The Bed & Breakfast Package Rate is not sold at Ashbury Express or Ashbury Inn & Suites hotels.
